title: Sufficiency of Scripture
definition: The Sufficiency of Scripture means God has given His people everything necessary in His Word for knowing Him, receiving salvation, growing in godliness, and walking faithfully with Christ.
summary: The Sufficiency of Scripture means God has given His people everything necessary in His Word for knowing Him, receiving salvation, growing in godliness, and walking faithfully with Christ.
christFocus: Jesus is the center of God’s saving revelation, and Scripture is sufficient because it faithfully reveals Him, His Gospel, His commands, His promises, and His way of discipleship.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture is sufficient because God has given what His people truly need. The Bible does not answer every curiosity, but it does reveal the truth needed for salvation, worship, obedience, endurance, correction, and spiritual growth.

The sufficiency of Scripture protects believers from chasing every new voice, trend, secret teaching, or spiritual shortcut. This does not mean Christians cannot learn from teachers, counselors, pastors, or study resources. It means every helpful resource must remain under Scripture, because Scripture alone carries final authority from God.

This doctrine is deeply hopeful. A new believer does not need hidden knowledge to begin following Jesus. A person in recovery does not need a complicated system to know where truth begins. A church-hurt believer does not need another controlling voice; they need the steady Word of God pointing them back to Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people live spiritually exhausted, believing they must find one more book, one more voice, one more experience, or one more secret before they can truly grow. The sufficiency of Scripture gives rest because God has not hidden the path of life from His people.

When Scripture is not treated as sufficient, people can be controlled by personality, tradition, pressure, fear, or private claims of authority. The Word of God keeps Christ’s people grounded in truth.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Build your life on Scripture as the trustworthy foundation for faith and obedience. Use teachers and resources with gratitude, but test everything by God’s Word, pray for the Spirit’s help, and take the next faithful step Christ has made clear.
